# Judith Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** Judith threw herself face down on the floor. She poured ashes over her head. She pulled back her outer garment to bare the sackcloth beneath. In Jerusalem at that same hour the evening sacrifice was rising in smoke to God. And Judith cried out to the Lord — a cry that filled the room:

**9:2** "Lord God of my ancestor Simeon — you are the one who put a sword in his hands to take vengeance on foreigners who stripped a virgin bare, shamed her, defiled her body against your own command. You had said it would not happen. They did it anyway.

**9:3** So you handed their rulers over to be cut down. Their bed — fouled by their treachery — you soaked with blood. You killed the slaves along with their lords. You pulled their lords down from their thrones.

**9:4** Their wives became plunder, their daughters were dragged into captivity, and everything they owned was divided up among the sons who love you — the ones who burned with your zeal and could not stomach the contamination of their own blood, and who cried out to you. O God — my God — listen to me too. I am a widow.

**9:5** You have done it all: past things, the things that came after, what is happening now, what is yet to come. You have planned everything — present and future. It all comes to pass because you intended it. Your purposes step forward and say: here we are.

**9:6** All your ways are set in advance. Your judgment is perfect foreknowledge.

**9:7** Look at the Assyrians. They have amassed a massive military machine — horses, riders, infantry ranked in columns, shields, spears, bows, slings. Their whole confidence rests on their weapons. They do not know the first thing about you — they do not know that you are the Lord who unmakes armies.

**9:8** That is your name: the Lord. Smash their power with your power. Shatter their force with your fury. Because they have set their minds on defiling your sanctuaries — on profaning the dwelling where your glorious name rests — on hacking down with iron the very horn of your altar.

**9:9** See their arrogance. Unleash your wrath on their heads. Put into my hand — this widow's hand — the plan I have formed.

**9:10** Use the words of my mouth. Use my deception. Strike down the servant with his master, the master with his servant. Let a woman's hand crush their pride.

**9:11** Because your strength is not about numbers. Your dominion is not about the powerful. You are the God who bends down to the humble. You are the helper of the small, the upholder of the weak, the protector of the despairing, the savior of those who have no hope left.

**9:12** Yes — yes! God of my father, God of Israel's inheritance, Master of heaven and earth, Maker of the waters, King of all you have made — hear this prayer.

**9:13** Make my words and my deception a wound, a gash, a stripe across all who have laid their plans against your covenant, against your holy house, against Mount Zion, against the home of your children.

**9:14** Let every nation, every people know and understand: you are God. God of all power and might. And there is no one — no one — who protects Israel but you."
